changelog: When to Segment: Added explicit "hold until complement" surface triggers (relative/subordinators, negation/polarity markers, post‑verbal agent/instrument phrases, short prepositional/temporal complements, vague pronouns/determiners, multiword adjectival compounds, numeric ranges) so the model recognises positions that should be marked only with lower confidence until disambiguating words arrive. This addresses placement errors where early cuts flip agent/polarity or misattach modifiers.

Priority Rules: Made ranking rules more concrete about demoting candidates that leave unresolved polarity, voice/agent, noun heads, pronoun antecedents, prepositional complements, or coordinated noun-number ambiguity. Added guidance on commas: prefer them only when they close a self-contained parenthetical; demote when followed by relative/subordinator signals. Added instruction to add conservative, low-confidence boundaries at safe punctuation/conjunction breakpoints when safe candidates are insufficient (to meet minimum-tag requirements).

Decision Procedure: Clarified the post-marking ranking step to explicitly lower rank for any candidate that ends immediately before the listed disambiguating triggers; instruct the model to add conservative low-confidence candidates at commas/semicolons/conjunctions only when needed to reach minimum coverage, and to rank them last. Reinforced that candidacy remains generous while ranking should capture these surface risks.
